Lina-CS: FYI SkyCore trial burned large embedding volume overnight, QA flagged runway risk for their upcoming demo. Need QBR-ready mitigation and a short enablement ask.

Marcus-FinOps: Running quick numbers. 7-day avg = 320k tokens/day, yesterday peak = 1.05M. If peaks continue -> est +$4k/mo.

Ivy-AE: They bulk-uploaded a corpus and set batch size=2048 to speed up. Demo is Fri; they want full throughput.

Lina-CS: Short plan: 1) apply temporary concurrency cap on their API key 2) create two-scenario forecast (pilot vs capped) for QBR slide 3) offer 90-min enablement to tune batch size/caching 4) consider $1k demo credit if runway < 2 weeks.

Marcus-FinOps: I'll post the scenario table (columns: scenario, daily_tokens, monthly_tokens, est_cost_delta, runway_days) in 90m and add an emergency alert at 90% prepaid.

Ivy-AE: I'll check if AE can approve $1k credit; if not, we'll propose reserved capacity.

ops-bot: Suggested policy: rate_limit(api_key=skycore_key, max_concurrent=4, max_rps=20).

Lina-CS: Action owners: Marcus -> forecast table + alert; Ivy -> credit confirmation + CRM note; Lina -> draft enablement agenda and QBR slide.

Marcus-FinOps: Posted forecast summary: pilot_daily=1,050,000 -> monthly 31.5M -> est +$4,536; capped_40% -> daily 420,000 -> monthly 12.6M -> est +$1,714. Assumes $0.000144/token.

Ivy-AE: AE approves $1k demo credit contingent on attending enablement call. Logged in CRM.

Lina-CS: Scheduling enablement for tomorrow AM. Will attach slide when ready. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth for QBR actions.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: by Ivy-AE)
